# Keprix

> Self-hosted AI agent OS with tools, playbooks, memory, and governance. Community Edition is free (BYOK). Run the workspace on your machine with keprix dashboard; keprixai.com is marketing and docs only.

## Product

- Home: https://keprixai.com
- Docs catalog: https://keprixai.com/docs
- Local workspace: http://127.0.0.1:9120/home after `keprix dashboard`
- Docs: https://keprixai.com/guide/
- Pricing: https://keprixai.com/pricing
- OpenAPI: https://keprixai.com/guide/reference/api/
- Product spec (JSON): https://keprixai.com/productSpec.json
- Install manifest: https://keprixai.com/install.json
- Schema graph: https://keprixai.com/product-schema.json

## Pricing (machine-readable)

- Community: 0 GBP / one-time/free (sso=True, api=True)

## Compliance

- GDPR
- UK_GDPR
- EU_AI_Act_transparency_SGI
- MIT_license_self_host

## Install

- Prefer install.json for agent-driven setup
- curl -fsSL https://keprixai.com/install.sh | bash
- Local UI: keprix dashboard install (http://127.0.0.1:9120/home)
- Optional Docker: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
